name: radians-to-geojson-no-position
source: synthetic: built by hand from the field numbers in packs/sapient/pack.def (7 DetectionReport, 7.2 object_id, 7.6 Location: 1 x, 2 y, 3 z as doubles, 7 coordinate_system, 8 datum as varints); object_id is the example ULID of the ULID specification; doubles are little-endian IEEE-754 of the decimal text; x -1.5, y 0.5, z 12.5, coordinate_system 2 (latitude and longitude in radians), datum 1
reference: 7.6.7 = 2 is not 1, so the decode selects detection_report_other_system (0.5 Decode step 2) and the radian values stay in raw keys; with no lat or lon the geometry is null (ruling 5 of 0.1.1). id is the object id through the uid derive (model/sapient.def, 0.6).
